'''Cycad''' was a [[Nomai]] geology apprentice under [[Coleus]] who worked on providing the ore for the [[Ash Twin Project]]'s [[supernova]]-resistant shell.<ref name=puns>CYCAD: If they're sealing off all entrances, I hope they've planned a-core-dingly! OENO: I thought you had forbidden your apprentice from making puns, Coleus. COLEUS: How else would he improve?</ref>

==Advanced Warp Core discussion==
During a discussion on whether the Nomai should retrieve [[the Vessel]]'s [[Advanced Warp Core]] from [[Dark Bramble]], Cycad pointed out that his mentor Coleus and Melorae had found out that the [[Anglerfish]] were blind, and that they could use this knowledge to avoid them.<ref>CYCAD: My mentor (Coleus) and his old mentor once discovered and studied an anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin. Using that knowledge, we could avoid the anglerfish entirely!</ref> However, Coleus quickly reminded him that they had never tested their hypothesis on a living Anglerfish.<ref>COLEUS: What Melorae and I learned from that fossil would theoretically help us evade the anglerfish, but our hypothesis was never tested on a live specimen.</ref> 

==The Ash Twin Project's shell==
Later on, Cycad moved with Coleus and [[Oeno]] to [[Timber Hearth]], where they identified suitable mining sites for the Ash Twin Project's shell.<ref name=ore>COLEUS: I’m relieved by our clan’s decision to use Timber Hearth’s ore only for constructing the shell.</ref> He initially thought they would use Timber Hearth's ore to build the remaining warp towers on [[Ash Twin]], but Oeno explained to him that they would only use the ore for the protective shell.<ref>CYCAD: Isn’t this the ore for the remaining towers being built on Ash Twin? The completed towers I’ve seen are quite large! OENO: No, the material for those towers is all being taken from Ash Twin. The ore we’re mining here will be used to craft an immensely thick protective shell that will physically seal off the chamber inside Ash Twin’s core.</ref> When they found out that [[Timber_Hearth#First_Encounter_Mural|mining site 2a]] was not safe for the [[Hearthian|native life]] living in nearby pools, Cycad proposed going to [[Timber_Hearth#Mining_Site_2b|mining site 2b]] instead.<ref>CYCAD: There are a few other cave sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and strata)? OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there. CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.</ref> He was fascinated with the native life, spending hours watching them.<ref>CYCAD: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They’re fascinating (I wonder what their fourth eye does)!</ref> Cycad also had a habit of making puns, which Oeno disapproved of but which Coleus tolerated.<ref name=puns/>

Cycad passed away when the [[Ghost Matter]] from the [[Interloper]] killed all Nomai, after it flooded the solar system without warning.<ref>The Nomai who came to our solar system were following a signal from the Eye of the universe. They perished when the Interloper arrived, bringing with it the deadly substance we called ghost matter that flooded the entire solar system almost instantly and without warning.</ref>
== Trivia ==

* ''[[Wikipedia:Cycad|Cycads]]'' are a class of seed plants. Individuals belonging to a species of cycad will be either male or female.
